# NKY Lawn Care Pros

## About
NKY Lawn Care Pros provides residential lawn care in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties): weekly mowing, fertilization, weed control, and fall aeration and overseeding. Free estimates by phone: (714) 494-9486.

## Services
- Weekly and one-time mowing (mowing, trimming, edging, blowing)
- Seasonal fertilization and weed control
- Fall core aeration and overseeding
- Fall leaf removal (add-on)

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
